Photos you take will be shared

While you are in this session, every photo you take with your camera is uploaded automatically and shared with all members of the session. Members can save those photos to their own galleries.\n\nPhotos taken before you join, screenshots and downloads are never shared. Location is removed from your photos before upload unless you turn that off in settings. You can pause sharing at any time from the app or the notification.
You are no longer a member of that session.
Waiting for a member to share the key

Photos are end-to-end encrypted. Until another member\'s app shares the session key with this phone, which happens by itself when one of them is online, your photos wait and received ones can\'t be opened.

Recall stops sharing this photo. Nobody can download it any more, and members\' apps delete their cached copies when they are next online.\n\nRecall cannot delete the photo from galleries where members have already saved it, and it cannot reach a member whose app never reconnects.
On by default. Turning it off shares where each photo was taken.

Allow PHOTON to keep sharing in the background
Your phone limits apps in the background to save battery, which can stop sharing when PHOTON isn\'t open. Allow PHOTON to run in the background while you are in a session.
